description:
Adds given set of compiled instructions to the current stack and waits for it to finish and return, provides an option to pass arguments to the executed [[Code]].
See [[Scheduler]] to learn more about how the code is executed and behaves.
examples:
<sqf>
_sum = [1, 2] call { (_this select 0) + (_this select 1); };
hint str _sum; // displays 3
</sqf>

<sqf>
private _hashMapObj = createHashMapObject [[
	["MyMethod", { systemChat ("MyMethod arguments: " + str _this); }]
]];

_hashMapObj call ["MyMethod", ["Hello there", player, 123]]; // hints 'MyMethod arguments: ["Hello there", player, 123]'
</sqf>
name: call

ret.desc: the last value given in the function is returned - see the topic [[Function#Return_Values|Function]] for more information

Item.desc: arguments that are passed to the function in the <sqf inline>_this</sqf> variable.
Item.name: args

ret.desc: the value returned by the ''methodName'' method

Item.desc: the name of the method to call (the method must be defined in ''hashMapObj''; see [[createHashMapObject]])
Item.name: methodName
